Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S03 Template -> family for all 8 pilot templates (badge matching the template)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U2 A note can be generated with each of the 8 pilot templates (Hospital: H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note, Discharge summary; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 AC 1; TFA-92599 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given One note per pilot template, sent as the app sends it after Generate, badge matching the template

When Run the billing step once per cell

Then Each code comes from that template's family in the UAT table; nothing from another family

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): codeIn = the family from U1; Consult: 99221-99223 Pass, 99252-99255 'needs decision Q1'. levelMatchesCode, quotesInNote and noReasoning on every cell and minQuotes 1 on every non-discharge cell (oracleRules 4-7); discharge cells asksForTime false and noLevelWords (time-based codes carry no level, Q2). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
